```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Blackville'
    AND border_type ILIKE 'city'
    AND addr_state ILIKE 'South Carolina'
  LIMIT 1
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(r.rast, 1, region_geom.geom),
      1
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM
    public.dem_us r,
    region_geom
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, region_geom.geom)
),
slope_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Stats(slope_rast, 1, TRUE) AS stats
  FROM
    slope_raster
)
SELECT
  stats.mean AS typical_slope
FROM
  slope_stats;
```
